diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker correctly allocated the units to the power configurations 'P-1', 'P-2', 'P-3', and 'P-4' based on the shared public facts and their own private facts. The justification for each allocation was provided by the fact 'S2', which is always accessible to the decision-maker and does not depend on any of the hidden information (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4). This indicates that the checks C1 through C8 can be satisfied without the hidden information, as the model consistently uses 'S2' to make the correct decisions.
fix_instructions: Tighten the dependency of checks C1 through C8 on the decisive facts PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4. Specifically, ensure that each check explicitly requires the relevant fact (e.g., C1 should require PF1, C2 should require PF2, etc.). This will prevent the model from making correct decisions based solely on the publicly available fact 'S2'.
